title: Stir-Fried British Beef with Lemongrass
description: A Chinese-inspired dish that combines the flavors of Britain with the zest of lemongrass. This quick and easy recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the aerated oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add the sliced British beef and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until browned.
Remove the beef from the wok and set aside.
Add the bruised lemongrass to the wok and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant.
Add the sliced nimble mushrooms and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the stew broth, soy sauce, honey, ginger, and garlic to the wok.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Return the beef to the wok and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the beef and sauce over steamed rice or noodles.
Garnish with sliced lemongrass and serve immediately.
